data.name: QueryDuplicateDevicesInfo
data.value:
-- First, parse all rules to extract all contained guids into the #RuleGuids table IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#RuleGuids', 'U') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #RuleGuids; CREATE TABLE #RuleGuids ( rule_id CHAR(36) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS, guid_value CHAR(36) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS INDEX IX_Rule_Guid CLUSTERED) DECLARE @guidPattern VARCHAR(512) = '%[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]%'
;WITH rule_guids_cte(rule_id, guid_val, def2, start_pos, [Definition]) AS ( SELECT IDRule , SUBSTRING([Def], [StartPos], 36) , SUBSTRING([Def], [StartPos] + 36, LEN([Def]) - 36) , PATINDEX(@guidPattern, SUBSTRING([Def], [StartPos] + 36, LEN([Def]))) , [Definition] FROM (SELECT IDRule , CAST([Definition] AS VARCHAR(MAX)) AS [Def] , PATINDEX(@guidPattern, CAST([Definition] AS VARCHAR(MAX))) AS [StartPos] , [Definition] FROM Rules) R WHERE StartPos > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT rule_id , SUBSTRING(def2, start_pos, 36) , SUBSTRING(def2, start_pos + 36, LEN(def2) - 36) , PATINDEX(@guidPattern, SUBSTRING(def2, start_pos + 36, LEN(def2))) , [Definition] FROM rule_guids_cte WHERE start_pos > 0 ) INSERT INTO #RuleGuids SELECT DISTINCT rule_id, guid_val FROM rule_guids_cte OPTION (MAXRECURSION 0)
IF OBJECT_ID('TempDb..#AllDuplicateDevices', 'U') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #AllDuplicateDevices; CREATE TABLE #AllDuplicateDevices ( [IDHardware] CHAR(36) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS, [IDDevice] CHAR(36) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS INDEX IX_AllDuplicateDevices_IDDevice CLUSTERED, [DeviceType] VARCHAR(256) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS, [DeviceIndex] INT, [Enabled] BIT ) INSERT INTO #AllDuplicateDevices SELECT d1.[IDHardware], d1.[IDDevice], d1.[DeviceType], d1.[DeviceIndex], d1.[Enabled] FROM [Devices] d1 WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM [Devices] d2 WHERE d2.[IDHardware] = d1.[IDHardware] AND d2.[IDDevice] <> d1.[IDDevice] AND d2.[DeviceType] = d1.[DeviceType] AND d2.[DeviceIndex] = d1.[DeviceIndex] )
-- Now, find all the duplicates ;WITH Duplicates_CTE ([DeviceType], [DeviceIndex], [DeviceImportance], [Enabled], [GroupCount], [RuleCount], [DeviceLinkCount], [IDDevice], [RowNumber]) AS ( SELECT [DeviceType], [DeviceIndex], [DeviceImportance], DuplicateDeviceWithImportance.[Enabled], [GroupCount], [RuleCount], [DeviceLinkCount], [IDDevice], ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DuplicateDeviceWithImportance.[IDHardware], [DeviceType], [DeviceIndex] ORDER BY [DeviceImportance] DESC) FROM (SELECT [IDHardware], [IDDevice], [DeviceType], [DeviceIndex], [Enabled], (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM DeviceGroupMembers dgm INNER JOIN DeviceGroups dg ON dg.IDDeviceGroup = dgm.IDDeviceGroup WHERE dgm.IDDevice = AllDuplicateDevices.IDDevice AND dg.BuiltIn <> 1) AS GroupCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM #RuleGuids WHERE [guid_value] = AllDuplicateDevices.IDDevice) AS RuleCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT 1 AS C FROM DeviceLinks dl1 WHERE dl1.IDDevice = AllDuplicateDevices.IDDevice UNION ALL SELECT 1 AS C FROM DeviceLinks dl2 WHERE dl2.IDDeviceLinked = AllDuplicateDevices.IDDevice) LNK ) AS DeviceLinkCount FROM #AllDuplicateDevices AllDuplicateDevices ) DuplicateDeviceWithImportance CROSS APPLY ( SELECT [Enabled] + [GroupCount] + [RuleCount] + [DeviceLinkCount] AS [Deviceimportance] ) Importance )
SELECT DISTINCT rd.[IsRecordingDevice], [DeviceImportance] FROM Duplicates_CTE INNER JOIN [RegisteredDeviceTypes] rd ON rd.[DeviceType] = Duplicates_CTE.[DeviceType] WHERE [RowNumber] > 1
DROP TABLE #RuleGuids DROP TABLE #AllDuplicateDevices

data.name: CheckForLegacyRecordingServers
data.value:
IF (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.tables WHERE [object_id] = OBJECT_ID(N'RecordingServerService'))) OR (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns WHERE [object_id] = OBJECT_ID(N'RecordingServerService') AND [name] = N'version')) BEGIN -- No RecordingServerService table -- or -- RecordingServerService exists, but does not have version column. -- -- Both means that version is before we introduced column, so all recorders must be older than 2020 R1 SELECT COUNT(1) AS [legacy_recorders_count] FROM [Recorders] RETURN END ELSE BEGIN EXEC(' DECLARE @primary_recorder_type INT = 0
SELECT COUNT(1) AS [legacy_recorders_count] FROM [Recorders] r INNER JOIN [RecordingServerServiceRecorder] rssr ON r.[IDRecorder] = rssr.[recorder_id] AND rssr.[type] = @primary_recorder_type INNER JOIN (SELECT [pkid], CONVERT(INT, LEFT([version], CHARINDEX(''.'', [version]) - 1)) AS [Major], CONVERT(INT, SUBSTRING([version], CHARINDEX(''.'', [version]) + 1, CHARINDEX(''.'', [version], CHARINDEX(''.'', [version]) + 1) - CHARINDEX(''.'', [version]) - 1)) AS [Minor] FROM [RecordingServerService] ) rss ON rss.[pkid] = rssr.[recording_server_service_id] WHERE rss.[Major] < 20 OR (rss.[Major] = 20 AND rss.[Minor] < 2) ') END
